_comment: Share link opened-token test vector (#5275). token = lowercase hex of HMAC-SHA256(key, message), key = the bytes the link's # part decodes to (base64url, no padding), message = "spoken-margins opened v1 " + the 32-hex link id. The server keeps only sha256(token) as the opened mark (markHex). Generated once with Python's hmac; the Go store tests, the Swift tests (ShareLinkOpenedTokenTests) and the web tests (opened-signal.test.ts) all check against it. Not a real link: never reuse this key.
